question: A pipe can fill a tank in 15 hours. Another pipe can empty the filled tank in 40 hours. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, then the time (in hours) in which the tank will be one-third filled, is:
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by the first pipe to fill the tank = 15 hours.

Time taken by the second pipe to empty the tank = 40 hours.

We need to find the time taken to fill one-third of the tank when both pipes are open simultaneously.

**Formula Used:**

Work done per hour = (Work rate of filling pipe) - (Work rate of emptying pipe)
